title: PH60101: Lattice Defects
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Classification of lattice defects - point, line, surface and volume defects,
dislocations, stacking faults, grain size, lattice energy , strain fields ,
stable configurations , short and long range ordering, order-disorder
transformations. Estimation of lattice defects - kinematical and dynamical
theory of diffraction, contrasts in micrography and topography, techniques of
defect estimation, SEM, TEM , STM , LEED . Analytical approach - diffraction
profile analysis , diffuse scattering , anomalous transmission and Borrmann
effect. Effect of lattice defects on properties of materials- strength,
electrical and magnetic behavior, dynamic correlation. Controlling lattice
defects - cold working , quenching , annealing and other mechanical and thermal
treatments.
